gloss: with all one's strength; with full force

definitions.gloss: with all one's strength; with full force; as hard as one can
definitions.explanation: Using the maximum amount of physical or mental effort. Describes putting everything one has into an action.

examples.japanese: {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投|な}げた→投げる：01135_nageru⟧。
examples.english: I threw the ball with all my strength.

examples.japanese: {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧、⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飛|と}び{込|こ}んだ→飛び込む：04614_tobikomu⟧。
examples.english: I ran with all my might and dove across the finish line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦{綱|つな}→綱：03891_tsuna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧、{赤組|あかぐみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: The children pulled the rope with all their might, and the red team won.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧ (strength) + ⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧ (full). Can also be written ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧いっぱい. Primarily describes physical effort but can also apply to mental or emotional effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull with all one's strength)
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ (to hit with full force)
- {力一杯|ちからいっぱい}⟦{頑張|がんば}る→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧ (to try one's hardest)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: with full power — slightly more formal
- ⟦{精一杯|せいいっぱい}→精一杯：13774_seiippai⟧: to the best of one's ability — broader, includes non-physical effort
